It tells the table what institutions are nearby, which borders matter, and whether the bearer is carrying ordinary purchasing power or a political claim. A banker may honor the rate while quietly reporting the transaction. A smuggler may pay extra for it because official channels are closed. That is why Waluigi refuses to flatten every currency into one yellow pile, no matter how loudly Wario asks.
